{{Quote|Doctor Meln, at your service.|Meln|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Otak'or Meln''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] from [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] who designed the [[Barrager]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] together with fellow Doctor [[Ortis]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. After the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] took over Balmorra, Meln and Ortis were thrown into [[Gorinth Brig]], while the Barrager was left unfinished. In [[3642 BBY]] they were rescued from imprisonment by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizen and provided their help in getting the now complete Barrager into Republic hands.
